[CR CR4635 for 38.331] Reason for change: Correction of miscellaneous non-controversial errors (typos etc). Summary of change: SRS-TPC-CommandConfig field descriptions Corrected reference to clause 11.4 (was 11.3) in TS 38.213. 5.2.2.3.2 Acquisition of an SI message Corrected reference to specification, the number of slots in a radio frame is specificed in TS 38.211, not TS 38.213. CRs agreed to be merged at RAN2#125 R2-2400455 Correction on NCD-SSB for RedCap Updated the field description for nonCellDefiningSSB to also cover NCD-SSB based BFD/Beam management for RedCap UE. Impact analysis Impacted 5G architecture options: NR SA, (NG)EN-DC, NE-DC, NR-DC Impacted functionality: Miscellaneous Inter-operability: There are no interoperability issues. Consequences if not approved: Miscellaneous

[8] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.6095)
[CR CR4391r3 for 38.331] Reason for change: This running CR introduces the support of Rel18 features for sidelink. Summary of change: In 5.2 and 5.3, introduce the impact due to the additional frequency list and RLC bearer list. In 5.8, introduce the impact to SUI message, synchronization procedure, PC5-RRC impact for SL-CA configuration and so on. In 6.2, 6.3, 6.4, 6.6, introduce the impact on SIB12, SUI message, sidelink configuration via Uu-RRC and PC5-RRC. In 8 and 9, introduce the impact to specified configuration and pre-configuration. Consequences if not approved: Rel18 features for sidelink are not supported.
